messages:
Nina (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A. Main topics: sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partnerships updates. I'll field rapid questions for 15 mins.
Tara - VP Sales: Quick ask: current ARR coverage and demo->PO conversion rates? need numbers to share with SDR hires.
Nina (CEO): ARR coverage is ~3.2x. Demo->PO conversion climbed to ~8% after playbook changes.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Are we shifting marketing budget into partner co-marketing this quarter?
Tara - VP Sales: Not fully shifting, but reallocating a portion to fund partner-led webinars and joint content.
Maya (Finance): Budget note: we can fund up to $35k in partner co-marketing for strategic pilots; central approval required >$35k.
Ana (PM, Product): Pilot partner requested SAML SSO + webhook sync. Engineering impact?
Liam (Partnerships): Confirmed. Also they requested a short co-branded case study clause and a 5-business-day review for marketing assets.
Rachel (Ops): If partner chooses Dedicated, Ops will need a temporary SLA and an onboarding checklist. I'll draft both.
Ana (PM, Product): Engineering estimate: 2 devs x 10 days + 1 QA x 5 days for SAML/webhook spike. Recommend tagging ticket "partner-pilot-q1".
Tara - VP Sales: Discount guardrails: AEs may approve up to 15% off. Anything above needs RevOps + Sales exec approval.
Maya (Finance): Pilot pricing recommendation: 15% off list, time-limited, then renegotiate on renewal. I'll document accounting implications.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Growth asks for partner attribution tracking parameters for trials.
Ana (PM, Product): I'll add tracking events and param schema to the spike ticket.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll create a one-pager outlining co-sell vs referral flows for PMs and growth and post to #partnerships by Friday.
Nina (CEO): Action items: 1) Eng spike for SAML/webhooks (Ana + Eng). 2) Rachel drafts Dedicated runbook + SLA. 3) Liam writes partner motion 1-pager. 4) RevOps/Tara finalize discount playbook. Follow-up sync scheduled 8 in calendar.
all-hands-bot: Follow-up "Partner Pilot Sync" created: Tue 10:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Liam (Partnerships): Sharing partner name via DM per NDA.
Tara - VP Sales: Please flag any resource conflicts to Nina and me ASAP.
Nina (CEO): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Add follow-ups to the calendar invite or shared doc.
Ana (PM, Product): Spike ticket created and linked in invite.
Maya (Finance): I'll prep pilot billing/recognition note.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Will set up attribution tags and post event list in #growth.
Nina (CEO): Closing thread 2.
